summary: PR-1364 adds a format-identifier constant to PipelineReport.java, a non-security-sensitive reporting file outside every product obligation's scope. The ticket and independent reviewer are in order. The only code-review approval is for the first commit, and the follow-up commit changes the constant's value, which voids that approval under CHG-3. The CI record also fails CHG-4: its JUnit reports were produced on a developer workstation before either commit existed, so they don't show the suite passing on the final commit. To be accepted, the change needs a fresh approval of the head commit and a real CI run on the head commit.
